_comment: Copy to data/watchlist.json (gitignored) and edit. Each company may carry any subset of the vendor slugs below; only present vendors are polled. Slugs are the public board identifiers — find them from the offer URLs you already applied through (boards.greenhouse.io/{slug}, jobs.lever.co/{slug}, apply.workable.com/{slug}, jobs.smartrecruiters.com/{id}, jobs.ashbyhq.com/{org}, careers.{host}/jobs.json).
